verdict.rationale: Logseq has no documented native scheduler, trigger, or background-agent feature. The only built-in autonomous behavior is the automatic midnight Journals page, which users cannot configure. Background automation is possible only by wiring external tools, such as scripts calling the token-authenticated local HTTP API (whose methods mirror the plugin API), the logseq:// protocol from the command line, or third-party plugins. Missing for 10: native user-defined scheduled or triggered automations, headless or background execution independent of the open app, AI-agent automation features, and hands-on evidence of autonomous workflows.
